prompt: Crea un HandlerInterceptor que lea el header X-Openpay-Trace-Id, lo ponga en MDC, y controle concurrencia con un Semaphore que permita maximo 1 peticion simultanea por traceId+endpoint. Incluye el registro en WebMvcConfigurer.

assertions.text: All method parameters use the 'final' keyword
MDC.remove() is called in afterCompletion to prevent thread leaks
Semaphore.release() is called in afterCompletion (even on exceptions)
Uses StringUtils.isNotBlank() or StringUtils.isBlank() for header null/empty checks instead of == null
Interceptors are registered in a WebMvcConfigurer with addPathPatterns
Header names and MDC keys are private static final constants, not inline strings
